prompt: Name a country with territory inside the Arctic Circle.

answers.name: Russia
answers.fact: Nearly half the land inside the circle is Russian, including Murmansk, the largest city north of the line.

answers.name: Norway
answers.fact: Tromsø sits well inside it and supports a university, a brewery and a symphony orchestra.

answers.name: Canada
answers.fact: The line crosses Yukon, the Northwest Territories and Nunavut.

answers.name: Sweden
answers.fact: Kiruna is being physically moved, building by building, because the iron mine beneath it is swallowing the town.

answers.name: Finland
answers.fact: Rovaniemi sits almost exactly on the line and has built an entire tourist economy on that fact.

answers.name: United States
answers.fact: Only by way of Alaska. Utqiagvik goes roughly two months without seeing the sun.

answers.name: Iceland
answers.fact: The mainland stops just short of the line — only the island of Grímsey actually crosses it.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: Through Greenland, which puts the overwhelming majority of Danish territory inside the circle.
